evidence: Resolves a key through the input object's +0x30 virtual entry, looks it up via the global table at 0x7004650998, and follows the optional/default object path. It returns whether the selected object's first 64-bit word has any bits in mask 0xc000000000. The caller stores the result among per-object status values. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0119.c:18397-18440; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:35887-35889.

Requires selector 0x14 to return 9, a nonzero low nibble at record+0x20 (using the default record when needed), and then compares the selected object's 64-bit field at +0x74 after masking with 0xf80000000000 against 0x140000000000. Returns a boolean; its caller uses it as a gate before processing the record. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0055.c:26377-26420; decompiled/main/main_0054.c:21147-21149.

Resolves the record pointer from input+0, falling back to the default record if null, reads byte +0x0a, and maps its unsigned value into codes 0..4 (0 above 0x59; 1 for 0x50..0x59; 2 for 0x46..0x4f; 3 for 0x32..0x45; 4 at or below 0x31). The caller stores the returned code in a per-record output slot. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:15104-15147; decompiled/main/main_0113.c:6758-6759.

Reads a provider ID from input+0x8 (via the +0x38 nested field), resolves the corresponding global record, follows its +0x30 nested provider, queries nested attribute ID 0x12 through nested_attribute_provider_get_float, and converts the float result to a signed integer. The caller consumes this in a contextual condition path. Evidence: decompiled/main/main_0024.c:17186-17214; decompiled/main/main_0109.c:5206-5207.
